name: Earthquakes & tsunami
summary: Largest quakes M5.8 off Peru on 13 Nov and near Papua New Guinea on 12 Nov; no M6+, all PAGER green
state: USGS recorded no earthquake of M6 or above in the seven days to 16 Nov. The largest were an M5.8 about 79 km west-south-west of Changuillo, Peru, on 13 Nov and an M5.8 north-west of Kavieng, Papua New Guinea, on 12 Nov; an M5.5 struck near Union, Philippines, on 15 Nov. All were rated PAGER green (USGS).
for_you: No damaging earthquake or tsunami is flagged; in quake zones follow local civil defence advice.
rubric_hit: max magnitude 6.6 below the 7 Watch line

sources.title: USGS — M5.8, 79 km WSW of Changuillo, Peru
USGS — M5.5, 9 km E of Union, Philippines

why: Large earthquakes can kill thousands in seconds and disrupt global supply chains (chips, cars).
drivers: Tectonics — unpredictable; impact depends on depth, location and building standards.

rubric.alert: PAGER red, or a tsunami causing damage.
rubric.watch: M7+ in the past 7 days, or PAGER orange, or a tsunami warning issued.
rubric.normal: No USGS PAGER orange/red alert and no M7+ in the past 7 days.
